A '''Vodran soldier''' was among the [[Vodran (species)/Legends|Vodrans]] who served in the armies of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]] to protect his empire, the [[Daimanate]]. During the [[Battle of Gazzari]], the Vodran lost his [[Limb/Legends|legs]] but continued fighting. He was finally killed from a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] strike by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kerra Holt]].<ref name="KE 8">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']], Chapter 8.</ref>
